Purpose: Give implementation agents a staged plan for turning COX specs into working software.

Mission.Summary: Build the UI from COX specs before wiring local system integrations.

RecommendedStack.Frontend: React or Next.js with componentized layout
RecommendedStack.Charts: Recharts or similar declarative chart library
RecommendedStack.Backend: Node/Electron/Tauri/local service depending on deployment target
RecommendedStack.Storage: Local JSON or SQLite for early prototype

ImplementationPhases.Name: Static visual reconstruction
Tasks: Implement layout, design tokens, and component hierarchy.

ImplementationPhases.Name: Project discovery and metadata
Tasks: Populate project cards from mocked-then-real data.

ImplementationPhases.Name: Runtime controls
Tasks: Add start/stop/restart behind explicit safe API boundaries.
Add confirmation for destructive or risky actions.

ImplementationPhases.Name: Previews and analytics
Tasks: Add commit/activity charts and AI usage provider rows.

ImplementationPhases.Name: Testing and hardening
Tasks: Add visual regression tests, accessibility checks, and state-transition tests.

AcceptanceCriteria: The UI matches COX visual hierarchy, spacing, card surfaces, and responsive behavior.
Every implemented component maps to a COX component slug.
Inferred features remain behind safe defaults.
No destructive file operation occurs without explicit confirmation.
NonGoals: Do not implement real system-level process control before visual shell is stable.
Do not assume a specific backend framework unless selected by the user.
Do not add unrelated product features beyond COX scope.
